Exchanges

Cryptocurrency exchanges that let you buy or trade Monero.

Exchange Filters

Decentralized Exchanges

These options let you trade Monero directly from your own wallet, without a traditional exchange account. They're great if you want more privacy and control.

Name Fiat Crypto Visit
BasicSwapDEX Trade crypto trustlessly with no middleman (atomic swaps). ✗ ✓ Visit
Bisq Peer-to-peer exchange where you trade directly with other people. Supports BTC → XMR swaps. ✗ ✓ Visit
Eigenwallet Highly liquid platform for BTC to XMR atomic swaps. Buying XMR with fiat available in EU only (KYC required). ✓ ✓ Visit
RetoSwap Decentralized peer-to-peer exchange built on Monero. Supports fiat, crypto → XMR trades. ✓ ✓ Visit

Swap Aggregators

Easiest way to trade crypto for Monero without creating an account. These services compare prices from multiple swap providers and route you to the best option.

The aggregator itself doesn't hold your funds, but the service you end up using might still ask you to verify your identity.

For an up-to-date list with details and reviews, you can visit the community resource below:

KYCNot.me - Aggregators Community-curated exchange aggregator list

Tip: Some Monero wallets have a built-in exchange for convenience. Check out the community downloads for options.

Centralized Exchanges

These are the classic exchanges where you create an account, complete ID checks, and can deposit from your crypto wallet, bank or card.

Name KYC Fiat Crypto Visit
Bitfinex Trading platform with a wide range of cryptocurrencies and derivatives. Required ✓ ✓ Visit
Kraken Well-known exchange with strong fiat support and advanced trading features. Required ✓ ✓ Visit
KuCoin Popular exchange known for its large selection of altcoins, including Monero. Required ✓ ✓ Visit
